interface.title: Rare IEM Screening AI — Rare metabolic disease screening (LC-HR-MS)
interface.field: Clinical biochemistry / newborn screening for inborn errors of metabolism (metabolomics, LC-HR-MS)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of a measured batch, then expert review and sign-off of flagged results before referral
interface.what_it_is_for: Runs a two-tier screen on a table of newborn LC-HR-MS features: a classic marker cut-off, then ML re-ranking. It lists high-risk samples with their abnormal analytes (robust z-scores) and a suspected disorder, and lets a specialist record confirm/reject/repeat decisions in an audit trail that can be exported.

data.note: The app loads its built-in example feature table on start: 25 samples, columns sample_id, batch and FT0001–FT0047 feature intensities, with some missing values. The sidebar 'Download example table' gives the same file as example_feature_table.csv, and I read it. There were no test files, so nothing could be uploaded. browser_upload refused the downloaded CSV ('no test file').

features.name: Two-tier screen results grid with flag-vs-call comparison
features.general: A results table that puts the simple rule's flag next to the final model call for each item, highlights the positives, and gives the abnormal measurements behind each call
features.specific: Results dataframe with risk_score, tier1_cutoff_flag checkbox, call, suspected_disorder, disorder_confidence and key_abnormalities z-score text (including ratios such as C8/C2, Phe/Tyr); HIGH RISK rows shaded red; Samples screened / High risk / Low risk counts above it
steps: Read the Samples screened / High risk / Low risk counts
Find the red-shaded HIGH RISK rows and their suspected_disorder
Read the key_abnormalities z-score text for each flagged sample (scroll sideways or collapse the sidebar)
Sort by tier1_cutoff_flag to set the cut-off positives against the final call
Sort by risk_score to rank samples
serves_tasks: See which samples were called high risk and why
Compare the simple threshold rule with the two-stage call

features.name: Human-in-the-loop review queue with audit trail
features.general: A queue of flagged items. Each one opens to show its evidence and a checklist, and has three decision buttons. Every decision is added, with a timestamp, to a log that lasts the session and can be exported as CSV
features.specific: Specialist review queue: one expander per HIGH RISK sample showing key abnormalities and the raw-data checklist (plain text, no checkboxes), with Confirm: refer for diagnostic test / Reject: analytical artefact / Request repeat sample. Decisions feed the Audit trail table (sample_id, decision, ISO time), and Export audit log writes review_audit_log.csv
steps: Expand a flagged sample from the queue
Read its key abnormalities and the raw-data checklist
Press one of the three decision buttons
Watch the decision appear as a timestamped row in the Audit trail; a later decision on the same sample adds a row rather than replacing the old one
Press Export audit log to download the trail as CSV
serves_tasks: Inspect a flagged sample's evidence and record a decision
Export the decision log for audit
